Artifact.description: A tracked file. ``derived_from`` is the constructive trace (artifact ids).
Artifact.title: Artifact

ArtifactVersion.description: Hashes of an artifact at one snapshot; ``content_hash == "missing"`` if the file is absent.
ArtifactVersion.title: ArtifactVersion

Assumption.description: Either a bounded variable (``bounds``) or a nominal ``value`` with optional ``tol``.
Assumption.title: Assumption

Evidence.description: One recorded result. ``id == content_id(self)``; no timestamps, so the id is pure content.
Evidence.title: Evidence

FreshnessClass.description: How an evidence item recorded at snapshot S relates to snapshot S'.
FreshnessClass.title: FreshnessClass

Interval.description: Closed interval [lo, hi] in `unit`, the quantity's canonical unit.
Interval.title: Interval

Policy.description: OR of ANDs: any one clause (1..3 conjuncts) of fresh passing evidence supports the claim.
Policy.title: Policy

Producer.description: Metadata of a registered evidence producer.
Producer.title: Producer

ReasonCode.description: Machine-readable reasons; table with meanings in docs/03-domain-model.md §6.
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

Requirement.description: ``limit`` is absolute and in the canonical unit of ``quantity``.
Requirement.title: Requirement

Snapshot.description: ``id`` is the content hash of everything except ``id`` and the informational ``git_rev``.
Snapshot.title: Snapshot

Status.description:
Claim status.

Declaration order is NOT the evaluation order; the rules (VIOLATED → STALE (lost fail) → WAIVED
→ SUPPORTED → STALE → INCONCLUSIVE) are in docs/03-domain-model.md §3.
Status.title: Status

Tolerance.description: Declared sensitivity of an output to a params field; kappa is applied once, at inflation.
Tolerance.title: Tolerance

Verdict.description: Three-valued outcome of one evidence item against one requirement.
Verdict.title: Verdict
